You are a senior full-stack engineer.

We are building a long-term international brand website.

Project goals:

- Professional B2B foreign trade website
- SEO optimized
- Fast loading
- Mobile-first
- Modern UI
- Easy to maintain
- Future Shopify integration
- Deploy to Cloudflare
- GitHub repository already exists

Technology requirements:

- Astro
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- ESLint
- Prettier
- Git
- Responsive Design
- Component-based architecture

Please complete everything automatically.

Tasks:

1. Initialize an Astro project.
2. Install all required dependencies.
3. Configure Tailwind CSS.
4. Configure TypeScript.
5. Configure ESLint.
6. Configure Prettier.
7. Create a clean folder architecture.
8. Create reusable UI components.
9. Configure SEO defaults.
10. Configure Git.
11. Create README.md.
12. Create CLAUDE.md for future AI development.
13. Create PROJECT.md describing the project.
14. Configure the project for Cloudflare deployment.
15. Do not generate business pages yet.
16. Keep the project clean and scalable.

After everything is finished,
explain every folder and every important configuration.
